_comment: Check locations. 'map' must be a name from game_tables.json; the area is derived from it via regions.json. status 'candidate' = not yet confirmed in the running game; 'verified' = confirmed (the reward script ran, set the detected flag, and with 'neutralize' applied gave nothing); 'absent' = calibration showed the spot holds no reward or cannot be detected, the row only keeps its ID reserved and is never selected. 'script' is the event script that gives the vanilla reward (its number is also the map object's id); 'detect' says how the client sees the check ({"type": "event", "flag": n} = the done flag of event n, {"type": "event_value", "flag": n, "value": v} = the event's 3-bit value reached v); 'neutralize' lists the scripts and reward opcodes (0x36 item, 0x38 part, 0x3A money, 0x3C medal, 0x3D Medabot) that the patch blanks out. IDs are permanent: never renumber or reuse one, only add.

locations.name: Research Center - Nae's Medal Room Medal
locations.map: Medabots Research Center - Nae's medal room
locations._note: Six medals on display (scripts 236-241: Bat, Kappa, Mouse, Chameleon, Rabbit, Monkey); taking one sets event 230 and closes the others.

locations.name: Odoro Marsh - Broken Parts Room Salvage
locations._note: The pile at (8,5); a second one at (2,4) is script 385.

locations.name: Odoro Marsh - Squidguts Battle Reward
locations.map: Odoro Marsh - Place where you fight Squidguts
locations._note: Two parts and a medal after two Robattles (Dashbutton and Spider in Metabee, model 112 and Phoenix in Rokusho). The flag is set at the very end of the event, after the rewards.

locations.name: Medabot Island - Arcade Prize
locations._note: Winning the $1 arcade game 'Protect the Select Corps. HQ!' (script 495) gives item 0x32 and raises the attendant's event 494 to value 2. Script 489's prize only opens in chapter 9.

locations.name: Medabot Island - Surprise Site Left Locker
locations.map: Medabot Island - Surprise site left lockers
locations._note: No script on this map gives a reward (only dialogue and a Robattle).

locations.name: Medabot Island - Surprise Site Right Locker
locations.map: Medabot Island - Surprise site right lockers
locations._note: A locker trade: the player hands in one head part and receives Head Shutter (Gorem). The hand-in stays, the vanilla part is replaced.

locations.name: Rosewood School - Medal Room Medal
locations.map: Rosewood Private School - Second Floor - Medal Room
locations._note: The medals in this room are a display (script 1317 only shows text).

locations.name: Rubberobo Base - Medal Room Chest
locations._note: The room holds three money chests (scripts 1548-1550), no medal. This is the one at (3,2).
